name: TransmogAppearanceList
summary: One appearance-set member of the Transmog replicated state in the client reader's element-count-zero branch: a prefix-varint delta count (pinned to 0), the strict zero-or-one delta, then a prefix-varint element count and that many big-endian u64. The masked-map branch is the sibling card codec.transmog-captured-appearances.
purpose: Name the zero-count member layout that the Transmog presence mask selects (group 0 member 1 of codec.transmog-replicated-state).

fields.name: deltaCount
fields.note: The prefix-varint element count 0x14365f1e0 reads before it branches. It is 0 in the measured capturedWeaponAppearances body, which selects the reader's +0x78 branch; the non-zero masked-map branch is the sibling card. The card bounds this field to 0 and refuses anything else.

fields.name: delta
fields.note: The zero-count branch 0x14365f520: a strict zero-or-one presence byte through FUN_1461adf60, then one prefix varint when it is 1. Measured 01 11 (17).

fields.name: elements
fields.note: A second prefix-varint element count and that many big-endian u64, read by 0x1415bcdb0 through 0x14087af30. 49 elements in the measured body.

evidence.ref: research/fixtures/wire/state-fragment-5691.hex: 00 01 11 31 then 49 x 8 bytes; byte-exact round trip.
